reason: The lettuce is ready, so cutting it seems the direct way to start the harvest.
expectation: I expect harvested lettuce that I can prepare for eating.

alternatives.reason: The mesh and tool might make a support for the potatoes, but I want to harvest first.

effect: The scissors produced leaves as expected; I can now prepare them.
reaction: A straightforward harvest, with a small sense of progress.
reason: Washing the fresh leaves with drinking water seems a natural step before eating.
expectation: I expect clean lettuce ready for the galley.

alternatives.reason: I also want to make room for potato stems, but will finish the lettuce first.

effect: The leaves are washed and ready to take to the galley.
reaction: The result is expected, though the sequence feels quite routine so far.
reason: The galley is the natural place to prepare and taste the lettuce.
expectation: I expect the first meal or a tasting of the harvested lettuce.

effect: The meal completes the harvest goal; the remaining task is to make space for the potato stems.
reaction: The green smell against the empty landscape makes the harvest feel tangible and earned.
reason: This is the only offered gameplay combination, and the mesh may make a support for the plants.
expectation: I expect a cut or shaped mesh support for the potato trough, though I am guessing about its exact form.

effect: The mesh became a support cage, confirming its purpose for the plants.
reaction: It is satisfying to turn cargo material into something useful, though the menu made the path obvious.
reason: The cage should give the potato stems support and room, and this is the only offered gameplay action.
expectation: I expect the cage to be fitted to the potato trough and the remaining goal completed.

effect: The cage fitted the trough and completed the remaining goal; the potatoes need more time.
reaction: The image of leaves above the dark cover gives the unfinished crop a quiet sense of anticipation.

mostWorthwhile.text: The first meal's sharp green smell against the barren view made the earlier work feel personal and tangible.

leastWorthwhile.text: Washing the lettuce was plausible but a routine intermediate step with little discovery.

surprise.text: Nothing strongly surprised me; the mesh became the support I had guessed, while the sensory detail of the meal was more evocative than I expected.

arbitrary.text: No action felt without purpose, though the menu largely told me what could be combined, especially once only one gameplay choice remained.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue: the meal and the still-developing potatoes give the settlement a human rhythm, and I am curious about the ice fragment from the prior background.
